description: Erection of a rooftop pavilion at eighth floor level and extension of the existing core to provide access to the new eighth floor together with external alterations at ground level to the Alfred Place elevation and a new terrace to the rear at first floor level.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans 2453-BG-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-00.100, rev P01; 2453-BGA-ZZ-XX-DR-A-15.274, rev P01; 2453-BGA-ZZ-XX-DR-A-15.271, rev P01; 2453-BGA-ZZ-XX-DR-A-15.272, rev P01; 2453-BGA-ZZ-XX-DR-A-15.273, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-B1-DR-A-10.109, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-00-DR-A-10.110, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-01-DR-A-10.111, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-02-DR-A-10.112, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-03-DR-A-10.113, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-04-DR-A-10.114, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-05-DR-A-10.115, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-06-DR-A-10.116, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-07-DR-A-10.117, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-07-DR-A-10.118, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10.151, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10.173, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10.174, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10.152, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10.153, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10.171, rev P01; 2453-BG-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10.172, rev P01; 2453-BGA-ZZ-XX-DR-A-20.171, rev P02; 2453-BGA-ZZ-XX-DR-A-20.172, rev P02; 2453-BGA-ZZ-XX-DR-A-20.173, rev P02; 2453-BGA-ZZ-XX-DR-A-20.170, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-00-DR-A-20.100, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-01-DR-A-20.101, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-02-DR-A-20.102, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-03-DR-A-20.103, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-04-DR-A-20.104, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-05-DR-A-20.105, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-07-DR-A-20.106, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-07-DR-A-20.107, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-08-DR-A-20.108, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-08-DR-A-20.109, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-B1-DR-A-20.099, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-XX-DR-A-20.151, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-XX-DR-A-20.152, rev P02; 2453-BG-ZZ-XX-DR-A-20.153, rev P02; 

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.

Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 

Condition : 4 - Prior to commencement of the relevant part, detailed drawings, or samples of materials as appropriate, in respect of the following, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority:

a) Details, including plans, coloured elevations and sections at 1:20 of all new typical facade junctions (including at ground level, window / external door head and cill, and at junction with roof). To include any ventilation grills, screening, balustrades, parapets, gates, planters and associated elements and lighting fixtures;
b) Detailed plans, coloured elevation and section drawings, new extension at a scale of 1:20;
c) Details, including plans of coloured elevations and sections at 1:20 of all cladding and fa�ade treatment/louvres to any mechanical plant or machinery enclosures at roof terrace levels;
d) Manufacturer's specification details, including high resolution photographs, of all facing materials (to be submitted to the Local Planning Authority) and samples of those materials.
e) Detailed drawings of gates, railings, doors and louvres on all parts of buildings which face the public realm.

The relevant part of the works shall be carried out in accordance with the details thus approved and all approved samples shall be retained on site during the course of the works.

Condition : 5 - The roof terraces hereby approved shall be used by the occupiers of the building only and shall not be used outside the hours of 08:00 and 21:00 Monday to Friday and at no time during the weekends and bank/public holidays. Live music shall not be allowed at any time on either of the terraces. 
Any outdoor music noise shall be limited to a level of LAeq,15min 65 dB within the eighth-floor level terrace.
 
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise or disturbance, in accordance with the requirements of Policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local  Plan 2017. 
Condition : 6 - A solid timber fence with a height of two metres shall be built around the lower roof terrace area at first floor level.
 
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise or disturbance, in accordance with the requirements of Policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local  Plan 2017. 
Condition : 7 - The approved basement cycle parking shall be provided in its entirety prior to completion of the roof terraces, and permanently retained thereafter. 

Reason: To ensure the development provides adequate cycle parking facilities in accordance with the requirements of policy T1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
